mentions.name: PWHL App
mentions.description: This is a native mobile app for the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL), built as a two-year passion project. It is privacy focused and ad-free, with a bunch of league features plus push notifications. It is built with Flutter, uses Kotlin and SwiftUI for native home screen widgets, and a simple Node.js backend powers push notifications.
